name: Assistant
description: Ask byōbu to do things, with Claude. It can use anything the other plugins offer, but opening a lock or a garage always waits for you to press Confirm. What you ask, and what it looks up to answer, goes to Anthropic. With a microphone and a speech server, you can also hold to talk.

schema.label: Anthropic API key
schema.description: From console.anthropic.com. Using the assistant is billed to that account.

schema.label: Model
schema.description: Haiku costs far less and suits simple commands.

schema.label: Speech server
schema.description: For talking to it: anything with OpenAI's audio API, like https://api.openai.com/v1 or a Whisper server on your own network. Leave empty to only type.

schema.label: Speaking model
schema.description: Leave empty for no spoken replies.
